visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up shot of a steaming Polish stew called Bigos, featuring thick chunks of meat and shredded cabbage glistening under bright lights. A white logo and yellow title text are overlaid at the top of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a male presenter standing in a well-lit studio kitchen with a green wall background decorated with wooden cutting boards and utensils. He wears a black long-sleeved t-shirt with a white sea turtle print, speaking enthusiastically with wide eye contact and active hand gestures. (3) A top-down shot shows a dark, textured pot into which sliced mushrooms are poured. A hand using a red and black spatula stirs the mushrooms as they begin to soften in the heat. (4) Slices of fatty pink bacon are added to the mushrooms, followed by a large amount of sliced white onions. The camera maintains a steady overhead perspective, capturing the ingredients being tossed together. (5) Chunks of raw pork meat are introduced into the pot and stirred vigorously to brown. White text graphics appear periodically to list the weight and name of each ingredient. (6) A large portion of fresh shredded cabbage is added to the pot. A variety-show style yellow icon with an exclamation mark pops up to emphasize the seasoning step. (7) Golden beer is poured from a clear vessel into the pot, splashing over the meat and cabbage. The mixture begins to simmer noticeably as the liquid is added. (8) Dried bay leaves and peppercorns are added to the surface. The camera zooms in slightly to highlight the aromatic spices resting on the bubbling stew. (9) Canned diced tomatoes and a bowl of sauerkraut are added in sequence, followed by several whole sausages. The colors shift from browns and greens to a richer red and orange. (10) A generous amount of yellow mustard is squeezed from a bottle onto the stew. Clear water is then poured in until all ingredients are submerged, and the spatula provides a final thorough stir. (11) The final dish is presented on a clean white plate, garnished with finely chopped fresh green parsley. The camera focuses on the steam rising from the succulent meat and tangy cabbage.
